messages:
Kayla: Heads up — I'm trying to push release v2.14.1 to prod in ap-southeast but deploy bot denies me due to role boundary. Anyone on deploy squad able to grant temporary prod-press for this window?
Devops-bot: deploy request denied: principal kayla missing role deployer.prod. Request ID: req-9f3a. See /deploy docs.
Samir: @Kayla I can grant JIT for 30m but need approval from security for cross-region MFA exception. What's the urgency?
Kayla: Fixes a regression causing KV cache thrash on Dedicated; we need the patch in next 20m to avoid cascading queue drop. Can we do canary in us-west first?
Jamie: I'm on call. We should pin the model-service to 2.14.1-rc2 on canary, not main. Also we need two approvers per policy. @Maria are you free to approve?
Maria: I can sign off. But per security, we can't bypass MFA for >10min. Samir, can you request a short-lived exception and rotate keys after? :thumbsup: 
Samir: Requesting JIT elevate for Kayla to role deployer.prod for 15m. Reason: hotfix KV cache thrash. Link: https://deploy/redwood/requests/req-9f3a
Release-bot: JIT elevation granted until 1755557700 by policy: canary-only, 15m. Audit: audit-773
Oncall: Let's run canary push to us-west-2 first, monitor latency for 10m, then promote. Rollback plan: revert to 2.14.0 tag and revoke JIT.
Kayla: Starting canary now. kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-service --namespace prod-us-west-2 --image=redwood/model-service:2.14.1-rc2
Samir: Observability: added alert thresholds & dashboard link. If error rate >1% or p95 latency +50ms -> rollback.
Jamie: Confirmed. Maria and I both approved in deployment dashboard. Post-deploy action: rotate deployer svc token and run perms audit.
Release-bot: Deployment completed to canary at 1755556902. No errors. Please proceed once 10m observation passes.
Kayla: 10m ok. Promoting to global prod now.
Devops-bot: Global push started, note: one node in ap-southeast failed pre-check; deploying with geo-fallback to us-east. Rolling back will require manual pin in region.
Samir: Noted. If ap-southeast stays flaky, we will pin region to us-east and open incident.
Maria: After deploy, file release note with exact perms changes and JIT exception id. Also schedule rotate keys within 1 hour.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. Lesson: update runbook to include MFA-stagger policy for cross-region hotfixes.
